spans.s:
The affix णमुल् comes after the verb पिष् 'to grind', when the words 1. शुष्क 'dry' 2. चूर्ण 'powder' 3. रूक्षे 'dry', in the Accusative -2nd case are compounded with it.

Terms: णमुल्

Also शुष्क and धृष्ट have acute on the first syllable.

Terms: accent

After 1. सु 2. सर्व and 3. अर्ध the first vowel of the name of a country gets the वृद्धि when a तद्धित affix with an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् follows.

Terms: वृद्धि

क is substituted for the निष्ठा त after the root शुष्।

Terms: निष्ठा changes

ष् is substituted for the स् of the words सुषामान् etc.

Terms: ष change
